pages.text: $(italic)Scion of a forgotten god. Towers over mortal limits with massive health and divine abilities.$()$(br2)$(bold)Divine Body$(): $(item)+40% max HP$() (4 extra hearts), the tankiest race.$(br2)$(bold)Divine Fury$(): gain Strength on command, on a 50s cooldown.$(br2)$(bold)Phase$(): pass through blocks for a moment.

pages.title: Traits (cont.)
pages.text: $(bold)Raw Diet$(): raw meat gives 2x nourishment, cooked meat 1.5x.$(br2)$(bold)Cursed$(): $(warn)fire burns you 50% hotter and the Nether gives you Weakness$(), but you can fight through it.$(br2)$(bold)Next: pair with a glass-cannon class. The +40% HP buys back what Archmage or Void Summoner gives up.$()
